P1.evidence: Acknowledged the application but explicitly declined to read it back — 'I saw your application that you filled out. Now I'm kind of an old school guy. So walk me through what's been going on.' Strong open question, but no four-part frame and no frame agreement was ever requested.

P2.evidence: Injury and limitation questioning was the strongest part of the call — 'Anything right now that pops up that limits your movements or is like a weak spot', plus targeted follow-ups on hip and lower-back stiffness and morning stiffness. Desk work and step count were asked directly. But age, height and weight were volunteered unprompted ('right now I'm six foot 215 pounds... and I'm 40') and never asked; the training week was volunteered when the prospect pre-empted the scheduling topic; results from current training, sleep and daily energy were never raised at all. Hereditary history came from the prospect, not from a question.

P3.evidence: Good work on the can't-do-it-yet goal — 'But would you like to?' on long-distance hiking opened the Iceland story where he sat out a day. The deeper bridge was run leading rather than open: 'there is something left on the table here? It's not only about aesthetics... but it's basically what I would call it, like playing a longevity game over here?' That doubled as the reflect-back and landed, producing 'I'd like to be able to hike like him when I'm 70'. Never asked who else this impacts, and never opened the goals with an aesthetics-and-function or mobility/strength/energy question — the goals arrived in the prospect's opening monologue.

P4.evidence: Phase never run. The prospect volunteered the whole raw material unprompted in his opening — a six-month self-directed home-gym block, 'it was all just kind of me figuring it out myself', 'I've realized that I need guidance' — and the rep neither asked what he had tried, nor what happened, nor why it did not stick, nor what is actually in the way. The structural root cause was handed to the rep and never developed.

P5.evidence: No consequence frame at all. The prospect supplied the raw cost of inaction himself — 'I feel myself getting worse as I age' — and the rep moved straight past it into presenting the programme rather than asking what two more years of nothing changing looks like, or whether he was willing to settle for it.

P6.evidence: Ran a variant commitment ask — 'the ultimate question is, are you willing to actually commit to this and show up for yourself, for your wife, and for your health?' — and correctly refused to accept the hedge, challenging 'Yeah, yeah, I think so' with 'You think so?' until he got a concrete proof-of-capability answer. But the belief question and the 'if you had everything you needed, is there any reason you wouldn't go all in' isolation were both run as softer paraphrases, and the whole check landed AFTER the three pillars had already been presented, which inverts the script's sequencing.

P11.evidence: Cleanest phase of the call. Payment link sent in Zoom chat and confirmed live ('Went through just fine'), Trevor onboarding booked for the next day with the invite confirmed received, and the coaching agreement signed on the call. Step 4 was only half done and only because the prospect raised it first — 'So you're using the school app' — after which the rep mentioned the weekly live session; no welcome-email instruction and no onboarding questionnaire was mentioned.

objection_plays.detail: Trigger was explicit self-doubt at 00:35:01 ('can I actually do this?... I'm a little nervous about making that commitment'). The rep engaged it properly and it resolved, but almost none of the scripted moves ran: no 'would it be fair to say you're looking for certainty', no pleasure/pain question, no bridge, plane or burned-before frames. Instead he improvised — reframed imposter syndrome as a high-achiever marker citing 'studies', then used an Andy Frisella line, 'tell me one thing in your life that is great, that came as a result of being comfortable'. Effective, but off-script and unrepeatable.

A clinical-fit trigger was present and unplayed. The prospect disclosed hypermobility with connective-tissue laxity, three surgically replaced cervical discs and active physiotherapy for shoulder and knee, and self-limited: 'I will need to start probably a bit lighter on anything that touches my shoulders.' There is no scripted play for this and the rep did not build one — he never asked whether the physio had cleared loaded or ballistic kettlebell work, and instead answered with his own hip-dysplasia recovery story. Same script gap already logged against the Tyron Giuliani call, recurring here with a heavier medical history.

notes: Discovery collapsed into presentation. P4 and P5 were skipped entirely and the pillars were delivered before any commitment check, so the sale ran on rapport and a shared hiking/travel interest rather than on structure — this closed because the prospect arrived pre-sold, not because the process worked. Coach priorities: run P4 even when the prospect volunteers the material (asking is the move), and build a clinical-clearance step into the injury questioning, which is otherwise this rep's strongest habit.
